longTitle.officialTitle: To amend chapter 5 of title 40, United States Code, to improve the management of Federal personal property.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Federal Personal Property Management Act of 2018”.

subsection.heading: Inventory Assessing and Identifying Excess Personal Property.—
subsection.chapeau: Section 524(a) of title 40, United States Code, is amended—

paragraph.content: in paragraph (11), by striking “and” at the end;
in paragraph (12), by striking the period at the end and inserting “; and”; and

subsection.heading: Thresholds for Capitalization and Accountability.—
subsection.content:
Section 506(a)(1) of title 40, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following:
“(E) Capitalization thresholds.—Establish thresholds for acquisitions of personal property for which executive agencies shall capitalize the personal property.
“(F) Accountability thresholds.—Notwithstanding section 121(b), for the management and accountability of personal property, establish thresholds for acquisitions of personal property for which executive agencies shall establish and maintain property records in a centralized system.” .
